card.name: Punctuation before chemotherapy drug names
card.fires_on: Commas, periods and "of" right before a likely chemotherapy drug name, mostly in lists of vinca alkaloids or platinum and taxane agents in interaction tables.

modes.label: After e.g. in vinca lists
modes.description: The period or comma after "e.g" or inside a list, just before vincristine or vinblastine.

modes.label: Between listed chemo agents
modes.description: A comma or period inside a list of anticancer drugs, before the next drug such as docetaxel or paclitaxel.
modes.example: Etoposide, vinorelbine, paclitaxel<<,>> and docetaxel No dosage adjustment

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting drug names starting with cis- or vin-, such as cisplatin and vincristine.
card.plain: It fires on the punctuation just before the next cancer drug in a list, especially vincristine or cisplatin.
